shared_elements: large curved arch / arc line as a dominant motif
smaller rounded or scalloped forms below the main arc
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single large curved arc drawn as a plain outline groove, with smaller rounded/scalloped forms beneath it, which gives a faint compositional echo. But A depicts a legible, specific subject \u2014 a boat with mast, sail-frame and a row of wave-like curves, framed by an arch \u2014 whereas B shows only ambiguous curvilinear grooves and lobed shapes with no identifiable vessel, mast or repeated wave register, so the correspondence stays at the level of generic curved lines.
